record.question:
The difference between the cost price and the selling price of an article is Rs 240. If the profit is 20%,
       then the selling price is:
record.explanation: Profit is 20% of cost; 0.2×cost=Rs 240, so cost=Rs 1,200 and selling price=Rs 1,440.
